visas.title: Tourist (L) visa, single entry, VIP service
visas.summary: Needed for the train into mainland China at West Kowloon on 24 Dec. Egypt is not on China's visa-free or 240-hour transit lists. We are taking the VIP service to skip the queue. Apply in person in Cairo; both of you should go.
facts: Cost each
4,560 EGP (about US$84): visa fee 400 EGP (reduced until 31 Dec 2026) + Regular service fee 2,080 EGP + VIP service 2,080 EGP to skip the queue.
Processing
About 4 working days for Regular; the centre works Sunday to Thursday. Ask whether VIP is also faster. Fingerprints are waived until 31 Dec 2026 and no appointment is needed.
Apply by
Online form by Sun 22 Nov, hand in 22–26 Nov (recommended). Latest safe date: Thu 3 Dec.
Where
Chinese Visa Application Service Center, Dokki, Cairo. Hand in 9 am – 12 pm, collect 1 pm – 4 pm. Phone 02 3748 3425.
Validity
Usually 3 months to enter; you need a stay of 10 days (24 Dec – 3 Jan).
On arrival
Fill in China's free online arrival card (NIA website, 12367 app, WeChat or Alipay) before 24 Dec.
documents: Passport valid at least 6 months (keep both valid to July 2027 to be safe), with two consecutive blank pages and no damage
Online application form, printed approval certificate
Photo 48 × 33 mm, light background
Round-trip flight booking record (the centre advises buying tickets after the visa is issued)
Hotel reservations for Chongqing and Shanghai (refundable bookings; addresses and dates must match the form)
Detailed day-by-day itinerary
Employment certificate
Recent bank statement in English with the holder's name and currency; for the partner's account, an English marriage certificate
steps: Create an account on the Cairo visa centre website and fill in the online form; upload the documents
Wait for the online review; fix and resubmit if it shows Rejected
When it shows Approved, print the certificate
Go to the centre with the certificate, passports and photos, and pay
Collect the passports about 4 working days later

visas.title: Short-term tourist visa, single entry
visas.costLabel: 10,000 EGP for two, cash on collection
visas.summary: Needed: Egyptians living in Egypt cannot use Japan's eVISA. Apply in person at the Embassy of Japan in Maadi; the embassy keeps the passports while it processes (at least 5 working days, not guaranteed; it advises 3 weeks ahead). As plan B this is the hard part: the China visa hand-in (22–26 Nov) also needs the passports, and waiting for the China result first leaves too little time for a 3 Dec departure.
facts: Cost each
5,000 EGP (about US$93), paid in cash when you collect the visa. Multiple entry 10,000 EGP.
Processing

Minimum 5 business days, not guaranteed; may take longer depending on the case. The embassy strongly advises applying at least 3 weeks before departure. Results are announced by uploading the acceptance number on the embassy website.
Timing

High risk. Counting embassy working days (Sun - Thu): submitting Sun 22 Nov or Mon 23 Nov gives the earliest result around Mon 30 Nov - Tue 1 Dec; submitting Tue 24 Nov -> around Tue 1 Dec; Wed 25 Nov -> Wed 2 Dec; Thu 26 Nov -> Thu 3 Dec, the departure day. The 5 days are a minimum, not a promise, and any request for extra documents adds days. The embassy keeps the passports while processing, so flights and hotels booked now could be lost if the visa is late. Prefer refundable flights/hotels, submit on Sun 22 Nov if possible with a complete file (stamped English bank statements, employment letters, marriage certificate translation), and keep travel insurance in mind.
Where

In person at the Consular Section, Embassy of Japan, 1st floor, 81 Corniche El Nil Street, Maadi, Cairo. No appointment needed for application or pickup. Sunday - Thursday 9:00 am - 2:00 pm (be at the gate at least 20 minutes before closing; security check). Closed Friday, Saturday and embassy holidays. No embassy holidays fall between 22 Nov and 3 Dec 2026 (next: 30 - 31 Dec). Documents cannot be sent by mail, fax or email. No designated agencies are mentioned; Egyptian citizens apply directly at the embassy.
Validity
A single-entry visa is valid for entry within 3 months from the date of issue.
On arrival
Fill in Visit Japan Web before landing for the immigration and customs QR codes.
documents: Visa application form, filled in and signed (one per person)
1 recent passport-size photo, white background (damaged or old photos refused)
Valid passport
Certificate of employment showing salary, tenure and position (enrollment certificate for students)
Original stamped bank statement for the last 3 months, in English
Detailed travel itinerary (embassy's English/Japanese form)
Flight itinerary (reservation)
Hotel reservation confirmation
If applying together as a family: proof of relationship (e.g. marriage certificate)
All Arabic documents need an English or Japanese translation attached; attach a copy of the flight, hotel and itinerary to each application; do not staple. Additional documents may be requested.
